subject: context/retrieval-efficiency
statement: After begin returns selected and possiblyRelated durable context, agents should treat that projection as the canonical first-pass semantic retrieval and must not routinely rescan .agent-knowledge with rg/find/grep. Exact filesystem search remains a fallback only when the projection is insufficient for a specific reason, when an exact file/line is required, or when searching repository content outside durable knowledge.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Implement R6.5 Retrieval Efficiency: begin is canonical first-pass durable retrieval and redundant .agent-knowledge rescans are fallback-only.
